cues.en: Mike: In this video, I'm going to show you how to compute inter-quartile range in MATLAB and in Python.
cues.zh: 這部影片示範用MATLAB與Python計算四分位距。

cues.en: We're going to first do this manually, so to speak, and then I will show you that there's a MATLAB function that will compute it automatically for you.
cues.zh: 先所謂手動計算，再展示MATLAB自動計算的函式。

cues.en: Nonetheless, I think it's worth going through the mechanics at least once during this course to make sure that you understand, really understand conceptually
cues.zh: 不過，課程至少一次走過運算機制，值得，確保真正從概念上理解，

cues.en: how the inter-quartile range is computed and what it means.
cues.zh: 四分位距如何計算、代表什麼。

cues.en: All right, so we are gonna start the way we always start, of course, by creating some random data.
cues.zh: 照慣例，先建立隨機資料。

cues.en: So I'm creating normally distributed random numbers and then squaring them.
cues.zh: 產生常態隨機數，再平方。

cues.en: So let's see what these things look like.
cues.zh: 看看樣子。

cues.en: So I'm gonna say plot data, and now we could plot lines here, we could make a line plot.
cues.zh: 畫data，可以用線，畫成折線圖。

cues.en: And this isn't really wrong per se, except that there isn't really anything that's connecting the points.
cues.zh: 本身不算錯，但這些點其實沒有任何連結。

cues.en: There's no connection between these points.
cues.zh: 彼此沒有關係。

cues.en: These are just random numbers.
cues.zh: 只是隨機數。

cues.en: So I think this is a little bit misleading because this line plot implies that if we were to have a measurement between data point 179 and 180,
cues.zh: 所以有點誤導，因為線圖暗示，在第179與180點之間測量，

cues.en: that we would know that that data point what had a value of 0.5.
cues.zh: 就會知道那個資料點的值是0.5。

cues.en: But that doesn't even make any sense because these are unconnected random numbers.
cues.zh: 但完全沒意義，因為它們是不相連的隨機數。

cues.en: So therefore I'm gonna plot about squares like this.
cues.zh: 所以改畫方形標記。

cues.en: All right, so here you see what the numbers look like.
cues.zh: 這是數字樣貌。

cues.en: They're all positive, not surprisingly because we're squaring all these numbers and there's more concentration here towards the bottom and less concentration towards the top.
cues.zh: 全為正，不意外，因為都平方，底部較密、頂部較稀。

cues.en: Also exactly what you'd expect for squared random Gaussian noise.
cues.zh: 正如平方高斯雜訊的預期。

cues.en: We can make a histogram, that should also be interesting.
cues.zh: 也能畫直方圖，應該有意思。

cues.en: And let's go for 30 bins just as a kind of arbitrary selection.
cues.zh: 任意選30個區間。

cues.en: Now there's nothing particularly important about the visualization that we are doing here.
cues.zh: 這裡的視覺化，沒什麼特別重要。

cues.en: I just want to get you into the habit of visualizing your results as much as you can, as often as you can, and in multiple different ways.
cues.zh: 只是讓你養成習慣，盡可能、經常，用多種方式視覺化結果。

cues.en: Okay, so what we're going to do, just looking ahead here, what we're gonna do is rank transform the data, scale them to go have a maximum value of one,
cues.zh: 先預告，會對資料做秩轉換，縮放到最大值1，

cues.en: and then find the data points that are closest to 25 and 75% of the data, and then subtract those.
cues.zh: 再找最接近25%與75%的資料點，相減。

cues.en: So let's walk through each of those steps individually.
cues.zh: 逐一步驟來看。

cues.en: So here I rank transform the data.
cues.zh: 這裡做秩轉換。

cues.en: I'm using the function tiedrank to get the ranks of the data.
cues.zh: 用tiedrank取得資料的秩。

cues.en: And so it was interesting to see what that looked like.
cues.zh: 看看轉換後長什麼樣，很有意思。

cues.en: So again, here was the original data, the raw data.
cues.zh: 這是原始資料。

cues.en: And now here are the rank transform data.
cues.zh: 這是秩轉換後。

cues.en: And you can see that these are uniformly distributed between zero and one.
cues.zh: 可以看到，均勻分布在0到1。

cues.en: So they actually are first distributed from zero up to, or actually one up to 1000.
cues.zh: 其實先是從0，或者是1到1000。

cues.en: And then I divide by 1000 to get them to be scaled down to between zero and one.
cues.zh: 再除1000，縮放到0到1。

cues.en: Technically it's a little bit above zero.
cues.zh: 技術上略高於0。

cues.en: We can say, see what the minimum value is.
cues.zh: 可以看最小值。

cues.en: It's 0.001, we could have computed that just based on this.
cues.zh: 是0.001，光看這裡也能算出。

cues.en: So the first result from tiedrank is going to be the number one, that's the lowest rank.
cues.zh: tiedrank第一個結果是1，最低的秩。

cues.en: And then we divide by a thousand.
So we get numbers scaled between one divided by a thousand, which is 0.001, which is this number, and one.
cues.zh: 所以範圍從1/1000，也就是0.001，這個數，一直到1。

cues.en: Okay, and then out of curiosity, so you remember I discussed that tiedrank is a non-linear transform so we lose information.
cues.zh: 好奇一下，記得tiedrank是非線性轉換，會損失資訊。

cues.en: So I'm just curious to see what it would look like if we make a scatterplot of data by data R.
cues.zh: 我好奇，畫data對dataR的散佈圖，會怎樣。

cues.en: Let's make these circles.
cues.zh: 用圓圈。

cues.en: So this is pretty interesting.
cues.zh: 很有意思。

cues.en: You see that they are non-linearly related to each other.
cues.zh: 兩者是非線性關係。

cues.en: So they're monotonically related to each other of course because the ordinal position in the original data defines the ordinal position in the rank transform data.
cues.zh: 當然是單調關係，因為原資料序位，決定秩轉換後的序位。

cues.en: But you can see there's this bend here and that shows you the non-linear transformation, or from the original data to rank.
cues.zh: 但這裡彎曲，顯示原資料轉到秩，是非線性的。

cues.en: Now there's nothing intrinsic about the tiedrank transformation that makes this look a little bit like a logarithm.
cues.zh: tiedrank本身，沒有什麼內在特性讓它看起來像對數。

cues.en: It just happens to look like that because of the way that I created the data with this squared term here.
cues.zh: 只是因為我用這裡的平方項產生資料。

cues.en: All right, now that we've explored the data visually a little bit and gained some intuition, what we're gonna do is find the values closest to
cues.zh: 視覺探索並建立直覺後，要找最接近，

cues.en: 25% to the data and 75% to the data.
cues.zh: 資料25%與75%的值。

cues.en: So that's why I rank transform and divide by N to scale up to one.
cues.zh: 這就是做秩轉換，再除N縮放到1的原因。

cues.en: So now the idea is that the data value or the data index that has the value closest to 0.25, this is 25% of the the way through the data.
cues.zh: 最接近0.25的資料值、索引，位於資料的25%位置。

cues.en: And likewise, 75, the index of the data value closest to 0.75 is 75% of the way through the data.
cues.zh: 同樣，最接近0.75的資料索引，是75%位置。

cues.en: In other words, 25% of the data are larger than this value.
cues.zh: 換句話說，25%的資料大於這個值。

cues.en: So that's what I do here.
cues.zh: 這裡就在做這件事。

cues.en: And then here I get the inter-quartile values.
cues.zh: 接著取得四分位值。

cues.en: Notice now here I'm indexing the original data, I'm not indexing the rank data because ultimately we don't really care about the rank transform data.
cues.zh: 注意，索引原始資料，不是秩資料，因為最終不在乎秩轉換資料。

cues.en: We're only using the rank transform data in order to obtain the 25 and 75 percentile indices.
cues.zh: 只用它取得第25與75百分位的索引。

cues.en: So those happen to be data number 366 and 136.
cues.zh: 剛好是第366與136個資料。

cues.en: And just to make sure we're clear about what this means, so data, and so this tells us that the data value
cues.zh: 確保清楚這代表什麼，data，告訴我們資料值，

cues.en: that happens to be at 366, so wherever that is, it's around here, that is the 25th percentile.
cues.zh: 剛好在366的位置，大約這裡，是第25百分位。

cues.en: Now, that's not 25th percentile here because this ordering is arbitrary, that means that 25% of the data are below the value of the data point at 366.
cues.zh: 不是指畫面這裡的第25百分位，因為順序任意；是25%的資料，低於第366點的值。

cues.en: Okay, so here we have our two quartile values and what we want for the IQR is the difference between them.
cues.zh: 有兩個四分位值，IQR就是兩者之差。

cues.en: So we want basically the difference between 75% and 25%.
cues.zh: 基本上，75%位置與25%位置的差。

cues.en: So the inter-quartile range here is computed to be 1.5194.
cues.zh: 這裡四分位距算出1.5194。

cues.en: So the only advantage of computing inter-quartile range manually this way with tiedrank and dsearchn and so on, is that you can also get the values of
cues.zh: 用tiedrank、dsearchn等手算，唯一好處，是也能取得，

cues.en: the 25th percentile and 75th percentile.
cues.zh: 第25與75百分位的值。

cues.en: Maybe that's useful, maybe not.
cues.zh: 也許有用，也許沒有。

cues.en: But if you want those values, then you can compute this manually.
cues.zh: 想要這些值，就能手動算。

cues.en: Okay, so then there's also a MATLAB function which is called IQR, inter-quartile range, of course.
cues.zh: MATLAB也有iqr函式，當然就是四分位距。

cues.en: And it's kind of interesting to see that these do not match perfectly.
cues.zh: 有趣的是，兩者沒有完全相同。

cues.en: So our manual method that I specified here and the MATLAB function gives slightly different results.
cues.zh: 手動方法與MATLAB函式，結果稍有不同。

cues.en: You can see they're the same for, in this particular dataset, they're the same for the first three significant digits after the decimal point.
cues.zh: 這個資料集中，小數點後前三位相同。

cues.en: And they are two 10 thousandths of a data point off.
cues.zh: 相差萬分之二個資料單位。

cues.en: And if you're curious, you can dig deeper, open up the IQR function, and look through MATLAB's implementation and you'll see it's slightly different,
cues.zh: 好奇的話，開啟iqr函式，深入看MATLAB實作，會看到稍微不同，

cues.en: it's a little bit more complicated.
cues.zh: 稍複雜一些。

cues.en: Basically, MATLAB is using percentile, which has a slightly different way of getting the 25th and 75th percentiles compared to what I'm doing here.
cues.zh: 基本上，MATLAB用百分位方法，取得第25與75百分位的方式，和這裡稍不同。

cues.en: Nonetheless, this is an insignificant difference, just a tiny difference in algorithm implementation.
cues.zh: 但差異微不足道，只是演算法實作的小差異。

cues.en: All right, so here we are in Python.
cues.zh: 現在來到Python。

cues.en: And what I'm going to do is start off by creating data.
cues.zh: 先建立資料。

cues.en: It's always a good place to start.
cues.zh: 總是好的起點。

cues.en: And you can see I'm creating normally distributed random numbers, 1000 of them, and then I am squaring them.
cues.zh: 建立1000個常態隨機數，再平方。

cues.en: So now we create the data, but we don't see what it looks like.
cues.zh: 資料建立好了，但還看不到樣子。

cues.en: So let's start generating some plots.
cues.zh: 先畫一些圖。

cues.en: I would like to see what this looks like.
cues.zh: 我想看樣貌。

cues.en: So plt.plot and data.
cues.zh: 用plt.plot畫data。

cues.en: Now we could draw lines here except that this isn't really a valid way, a useful way to plot these data.
cues.zh: 可以畫線，但其實不是有效、有用的呈現方式。

cues.en: And that's because when we have lines like this, we are making an assumption that if we would measure data between points 399 and 400
cues.zh: 因為線圖假設，在第399與400點間測量，

cues.en: that we would know that that value or we would guess that that value corresponds to 1.7 or whatever would be in between 399 and 400.
cues.zh: 會知道、或猜測，值對應1.7，或399與400之間的位置。

cues.en: But these are just randomly drawn numbers from a normal distribution.
cues.zh: 但只是從常態分布隨機抽出的數。

cues.en: So there actually is no relationship between successive data points and therefore line plots are actually not appropriate.
cues.zh: 相鄰資料點其實沒有關係，折線圖不適合。

cues.en: So we can do, let's try making these pentagons.
cues.zh: 試著用五角形。

cues.en: You don't really see these, but these are little stars here.
cues.zh: 可能看不清，但這裡是小星形。

cues.en: Okay, so we can see that this dataset is all positive.
cues.zh: 資料集全為正。

cues.en: So it's all numbers greater than zero and there's more clustering for this towards zero and less clustering as you get further away.
cues.zh: 都大於0，接近0處較密，越遠越稀。

cues.en: It's not surprising because we generated this data set by squaring random numbers.
cues.zh: 不意外，因為是把隨機數平方。

cues.en: Okay, now I'm also curious to see what a histogram looks like.
cues.zh: 也好奇直方圖樣子。

cues.en: So I'm gonna say plt.hist, and here we see a histogram with the default number of 10 bins.
cues.zh: 用plt.hist，看到預設十個區間。

cues.en: Maybe that's too few.
cues.zh: 可能太少。

cues.en: Let's try bins equals, how about 30?
cues.zh: 試bins=30如何？

cues.en: Okay, so, and then we see that there's a high concentration at low numbers and we get this kind of decrease in the frequency of numbers
cues.zh: 看到小數值處集中很多，出現頻率，

cues.en: as we get to higher and higher values.
cues.zh: 隨數值增大而下降。

cues.en: Now, there's nothing particularly important in this exercise about visualizing these data, but I want to instill in you a practice,
cues.zh: 這個練習，視覺化本身沒特別重要，但想建立一種實踐，

cues.en: a habit of visualizing data whenever you can, as often as you can, and in at least two different ways.
cues.zh: 習慣，只要可能，經常且至少用兩種方式視覺化。

cues.en: This is just good practice in general for working with data to visualize as much as possible.
cues.zh: 處理資料時，盡可能視覺化，通常是好做法。

cues.en: Okay, so now I'm gonna compute the inter-quartile range in two different ways.
cues.zh: 現在用兩種方式算四分位距。

cues.en: One is kind of a manual way where what I'll do is rank transform the data and then scale it down so it has a maximum value of one
cues.zh: 一種手動，做秩轉換，再縮放到最大1，

cues.en: and then find the indices corresponding to 0.25 and 0.75 in the rank transform data
cues.zh: 找出秩資料中對應0.25與0.75的索引，

cues.en: and then get those indices in the raw data and then compute the inter-quartilee range from there.
cues.zh: 再取原始資料的對應索引，算四分位距。

cues.en: And then I'm gonna use python's built-in IQR function in these stats toolbox.
cues.zh: 接著用stats工具箱的iqr函式。

cues.en: And well, you'll see that this number gives basically the same answer as what we compute all the way up here.
cues.zh: 會看到，與前面手算基本相同。

cues.en: But in fact, first I want to, let me see, I'm gonna split this cell again because I would like to spend a moment exploring these rank data.
cues.zh: 但先把儲存格再拆開，花點時間探索秩資料。

cues.en: So we rank transform the data, tiedrank transform, and then scale by N.
cues.zh: 對資料做同秩轉換，再除N縮放。

cues.en: So let's see what these new data look like.
cues.zh: 看看新資料。

cues.en: So plt.plot, dataR, make these squares.
cues.zh: plt.plot畫dataR，用方形標記。

cues.en: Now, unlike the original data, which were distributed in a way that had a lot of clustering towards zero and more sparsely sample data as we got higher up,
cues.zh: 原始資料在0附近聚很多，往上變稀疏，

cues.en: here we see uniform distribution between zero and one.
cues.zh: 這裡卻均勻分布在0到1。

cues.en: Of course it goes up to one because we divide by N.
cues.zh: 除以N，所以最大到1。

cues.en: Now you'll remember when I introduced you to the tiedrank transform, that was in the section on math prerequisites, that I discussed that the rank transform is a non-linear
cues.zh: 記得數學先備知識那一節介紹tiedrank時，談過秩轉換是非線性，

cues.en: and also lossy function of the data.
cues.zh: 也是有損的資料函數。

cues.en: So I'm curious to see what the original data looked like against the rank transform data.
cues.zh: 所以好奇原資料對秩資料，長什麼樣。

cues.en: So I'm gonna write data,dataR, data rank, and then we can just see what it looks like.
cues.zh: 寫data、dataR，也就是秩資料，看看結果。

cues.en: So it's not surprising that there's a monotonic relationship and that's because the ordinal position of the data, of the original data, defines the ordinal position of the rank,
cues.zh: 不意外，有單調關係，因為原資料序位，決定秩的序位，

cues.en: or in fact defines exactly the rank.
cues.zh: 或者說，恰好定義了秩。

cues.en: And it is interesting to see that this has kind of a logarithm shape.
cues.zh: 這看起來有點像對數，很有意思。

cues.en: And that shape the fact that we get a shape that looks like this is not something that's fundamental, it's not intrinsic to the rank transform, it actually just has to do with the nature of the data
cues.zh: 但這形狀不是秩轉換的根本、內在特性，而是資料性質，

cues.en: that we simulated the data as the data points squared.
cues.zh: 因為用資料點平方來模擬。

cues.en: So that's why we get this relationship like this.
cues.zh: 所以得到這個關係。

cues.en: Okay, so now we rank transform the data and then what we do here is find the point in the data that is closest to 0.25 and 0.75.
cues.zh: 秩轉換後，找出最接近0.25與0.75的點。

cues.en: And so the idea is that in the rank transform data, the data value corresponding to 0.25 is 25% of the way through the data values.
cues.zh: 概念是，秩資料中對應0.25的值，位於資料值的25%位置。

cues.en: And then likewise for 0.75, this is 75% of the way through the data values.
So 25% of the data is above whatever this point is going to be, which I'm calling Q3.
cues.zh: 25%的資料高於這個點，我把它叫Q3。

cues.en: And the way that I'm implementing this is using this argmin syntax here.
cues.zh: 用argmin語法實作。

cues.en: So basically what we're doing is taking the rank transform data, subtracting 0.25, and then squaring it.
cues.zh: 基本上，秩資料減0.25，再平方。

cues.en: So what that means is that the data value that is closest to 0.25 is going to be closest to zero.
cues.zh: 最接近0.25的資料值，就會最接近0。

cues.en: And then when we square it, that gets rid of all the negative signs.
cues.zh: 平方後，去掉所有負號。

cues.en: So it flips all of the negative signs, and then we find the point that is closest to zero, which is the point in the rank transform data
cues.zh: 把負號翻過來，再找最接近0的點，也就是秩資料裡，

cues.en: that's closest to 0.25.
cues.zh: 最接近0.25的點。

cues.en: Okay, and then once we get these indices here, then we identify the two data points in the original dataset that are at those two indices.
cues.zh: 取得索引後，找出原始資料集，那兩個索引的資料點。

cues.en: That gives us our inter-quartile values.
cues.zh: 得到四分位值。

cues.en: So that gives us the quartile value of 75% of the data and the quartile value of 25% of the data.
cues.zh: 也就是75%與25%資料位置的四分位值。

cues.en: And then the inner quartile range is just the difference between them.
cues.zh: 四分位距只是兩者之差。

cues.en: Okay, and then here I'm also using python's built-in function, IQR, in the statistics toolbox for the inter-quartile range.
cues.zh: 這裡也用統計工具箱的iqr函式計算。

cues.en: Now, in general, I don't really recommend going through all of this code just to compute the inter-quartile range, you can just use the IQR function,
cues.zh: 一般不建議只為算IQR，寫這麼多程式，直接用iqr即可。

cues.en: but I'd like to spell this out mechanistically at least once during teaching so that you understand conceptually where the inter-quartile range is coming from.
cues.zh: 但教學至少一次，詳細展示機制，讓你從概念理解四分位距來源。

cues.en: That said, there is one reason to compute inter-quartile range manually like this.
cues.zh: 不過，手動算確實有一個理由。

cues.en: And that's if you want the actual values for the 25 percentile and the 75 percentile, then you'll actually need to run this code like this.
cues.zh: 想取得第25與75百分位的實際值，就需要這樣執行。

cues.en: Okay, now if you look at these two numbers carefully, so this first number is my implementation of the inter-quartile range, and this number is python's implementation.
cues.zh: 仔細比較這兩個數，第一個是我的實作，第二個是Python的實作。
